title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
PGS Worldwide is actively seeking a skilled Manufacturing Process Planner to support our client’s operations in Fort Wayne, IN. This is an 11-month contract-to-hire opportunity. The ideal candidate will be experienced in creating and improving manufacturing work instructions and procedures, with a strong focus on Lean principles, safety, and process efficiency.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 4 years of relevant work experience

  • Associate’s degree, or equivalent four years of work experience

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal)

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel and Word)

  • Demonstrated self-motivation and ability to work independently

  • Attention to detail and ability to thrive in a fast-paced team environment

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Production or electronics background

  • Knowledge of electronics or manufacturing environments

  • Experience with CAD or other visual aids

  • Hands-on experience creating detailed work instructions in an MES system

  • Technical certificate or degree in Mechanical or Electrical disciplines

  • Familiarity with Aegis FactoryLogix a plus

  • Background in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, or Industrial Engineering disciplines

Responsibilities

  • Develop, convert, and maintain manufacturing work instructions and procedures

  • Apply Lean assembly principles to improve processes and workflows

  • Plan sequences of operations and specify procedures for assembly, disassembly, soldering, coating, and component installation/removal

  • Design sequences and procedures for fabrication of tools, equipment, and other functions affecting product performance

  • Ensure compliance with safety requirements and proactively maintain a safe work environment

  • Promote a culture of 100% quality assurance

  • Provide direct feedback to build and design processes for improved efficiency

  • Ensure product compliance by maintaining accurate and effective documentation (planning, AWI, OSOPs, etc.)

title: Systems Engineer
description:
PGS Worldwide is actively seeking a Systems Engineer to support missile integration and interoperability programs in Grand Prairie, TX. This 1-year contract-to-hire role will focus on system design, requirements, and verification activities to extend the functionality of the PAC-3 MSE Missile Segment to other combat systems.

The ideal candidate will bring proven DOORS and Cameo experience, combined with strong system design knowledge and the ability to collaborate across multi-disciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze, define, and document system requirements using DOORS

  • Perform system architecture analysis using Cameo, capturing use cases, interfaces, timing, and designs

  • Support integration, verification, and validation activities across missile and combat system programs

  • Collect and organize verification artifacts to support Functional Configuration Audits (FCA)

  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary subject matter experts to ensure system-level compliance and mission success

  • Work onsite in a classified environment as needed to support testing and integration

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace, Computer, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science/Software Engineering, or other STEM discipline

  • 3+ years of experience using DOORS for requirements management

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Cameo for system modeling and architecture

  • Familiarity with system design concepts and tradeoffs

  • Willingness to work onsite in a classified lab environment

  • U.S. Citizenship required due to program access requirements

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with C++, MATLAB, or Python

  • Familiarity with missile system fundamentals and aerospace system design

  • Prior experience with DoD projects, particularly Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) systems

  • Strong interest in learning missile, ground system, and fire control system operations

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

  • Willingness to work either 1st or 2nd shift as assigned

  • Availability to begin work on 11/3/25 in Greenville, SC

Desired Qualifications:

  • Prior avionics experience in aerospace/defense environments

  • Knowledge of Ethernet, GES systems, and wafer connections

description:

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with overtime as required

  • Comfortable with long periods of microscope and detailed bench work

The Solder Technician will perform high-precision rework, soldering, and inspection of SMT assemblies in support of aerospace and defense programs.
